name: rm_fillers
description: Remove filler words (um, uh, hmm) and surrounding silence from a clip

input.description: Source video file or trim spec JSON from a prior step

output.description: Trim spec JSON with filler word ranges removed and head snapped to first word onset

params.name: model
params.description: Whisper model for filler detection. Larger = slower + more accurate. English-only (*.en) models are auto-upgraded to a multilingual sibling when language is non-English.

params.name: language
params.description: Language code (e.g. es) for transcription and filler matching, or 'auto'. Selects the per-language hesitation-filler set and upgrades *.en models to multilingual.

params.name: window-in
params.description: Analyse only this window of --input (source seconds), instead of the whole file. Must be paired with window-out; also adds a `cuts` array (the complement of `keeps` within the window, each filler entry carrying the matched word as `text`) to the output.

params.name: window-out
params.description: End of the analysis window in source seconds. Must be paired with window-in.
